backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a Tetris backend with leaderboard score submission, mission management, and user profile storage, all protected by role-based access control (admin/user permissions).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the Web Audio API sound system fix in `useTetrisAudio.ts` and `App.tsx`, covering deferred AudioContext creation, autoplay policy compliance, mute toggle, music looping, and game loop wiring.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON file containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, used for build planning and documentation purposes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the TetrisVerse React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/public/app-ads.txt: Google AdMob app-ads.txt verification file declaring a direct relationship with the publisher ID for ad monetization.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wires all providers, manages screen navigation state, and attaches global interaction listeners to unlock the AudioContext on first user input to comply with browser autoplay policy.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright, app-ads.txt link, privacy policy, and a caffeine.ai attribution, styled dynamically using the current game theme.
frontend/src/components/GameBoard.tsx: Main game screen component that manages responsive canvas sizing, keyboard and touch controls, game lifecycle (start/pause/stop), and audio playback tied to the active theme's music file.
frontend/src/components/GameCanvas.tsx: Renders the Tetris game board, grid, placed cells, ghost piece, active piece, and pause overlay onto an HTML canvas element using the current theme and cell size.
frontend/src/components/GameOverDialog.t: Modal dialog shown at game end displaying score/lines/level stats, a score submission form with player name input, and navigation buttons for restart, menu, and leaderboard.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App-wide header with logo/home navigation, leaderboard and missions links, a language selector dropdown, mute toggle, and settings navigation button.
frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx: Static marketing/developer landing page for TetrisVerse that displays AdMob verification info, a link to app-ads.txt, and the publisher ID.
frontend/src/components/Leaderboard.tsx: Displays top scores fetched from the backend, filterable by game mode via tab buttons, with rank icons and formatted dates for each entry.
frontend/src/components/MainMenu.tsx: Full-screen main menu with themed logo, tagline, and navigation buttons for Play, Leaderboard, Missions, and Settings.
frontend/src/components/MissionNotificat: Displays temporary toast-style notifications in the top-right corner when a 'missionComplete' custom event fires, auto-dismissing after 4 seconds with a close button.
frontend/src/components/MissionsPanel.ts: Renders a full-page missions list with overall progress bar, showing each mission's completion status, progress toward goal, and reward, loaded from localStorage or defaults.
frontend/src/components/ModeSelector.tsx: Modal overlay that displays all available game modes in a grid, showing each mode's icon, difficulty (color-coded), description, and score multiplier for the player to select.
frontend/src/components/NextPiecePreview: Canvas-based component that renders a preview of upcoming Tetris pieces, supporting both vertical (sidebar) and horizontal (mobile) layouts with gradient-styled cells.
frontend/src/components/SettingsPanel.ts: Full-page settings screen with sections for audio mute toggle, theme selection, and language selection, persisted via their respective contexts.
frontend/src/components/TouchControlButt: Mobile-only touch control overlay providing rotate, hard drop, left, soft drop, and right buttons with pointer-event debouncing to prevent duplicate inputs.
frontend/src/contexts/GameThemeContext.t: Defines the GameTheme interface and a THEMES record containing full visual configurations (colors, background images, music files) for eight named themes (neon, retro, minimal, space, ocean, candy, sunrise, pixelCity), along with a React context for theme selection.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Defines supported languages, a Translations interface covering all UI strings, and a TRANSLATIONS record with full translations for ten languages, exposed via a React context.
frontend/src/contexts/TetrisAudioContext: Wraps the useTetrisAudio hook in a React context provider so any component in the tree can access the TetrisAudioSystem without prop drilling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using React Query, initializing access control with an admin token when an identity is present and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGameLogic.ts: Implements the core Tetris game logic hook, including board state, piece generation, movement, SRS wall-kick rotation, line clearing, scoring, and mode-specific behaviors (puzzle, insanity, challenge, etc.).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook that manage DFINITY AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout flow, and expose identity state (status flags, identity object, error) via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exposes useGetTopScores and useSubmitScore React Query hooks that fetch and submit leaderboard scores via the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTetrisAudio.ts: Implements a Web Audio API-based audio system hook that manages mute state, lazy AudioContext creation, sound effect playback with buffer caching, and looping background music with autoplay-policy handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useTouchControls.ts: React hook that translates touch events (tap, swipe) into Tetris game actions like rotate, move, and hard drop, with threshold-based gesture detection.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind base styles, OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for theming, game-specific neon color tokens, and utility animations like glow-pulse and scanlines.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/types/game.ts: Defines TypeScript types and constants for the Tetris game including game modes, mode configurations, tetromino shapes/types, board dimensions, and the overall GameState interface.
frontend/src/types/missions.ts: Defines the MissionData interface and a DEFAULT_MISSIONS array containing eight predefined in-game missions with goals, rewards, and progress tracking across various game modes.
frontend/src/utils/color.ts: Utility functions for adjusting hex color brightness by a numeric amount and safely returning color strings that may include CSS variables or RGB values.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence helpers and a function to remove parameters from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with OKLCH-based CSS variable colors, game-specific neon colors, Orbitron/monospace font families, and custom animations including glow-pulse and float.
project_state.json: Tracks the TetrisVerse project state at version 11, documenting architectural notes, known issues (Web Audio API sounds not working), and a list of existing implemented features for the rebuild targeting v46 functionality.
